judgment.rationale: The thread identifies app-specific deletion after Quick Accent selection, especially Notepad and first-character input in browser-based apps, but the original evidence is from 0.92.0 and no commenter confirms behavior on a current stable release.
evidence: The original reporter reproduced approximately half the time in Notepad but not Teams or VS Code.
Another user reports first-character deletion in WhatsApp and Slack when selecting the first accent.
The configured frequency/leftmost options did not avoid the Notepad behavior.
No current-version diagnostic or confirmation is present.
judgment.recommended_action: Request a current stable retest in one native and one browser-based application with a short recording.

fix_assessment.rationale: Current evidence may describe multiple timing-sensitive application behaviors and is too old to select a fix.

issue_context.summary: Quick Accent can delete the selected or original character in specific applications, especially at the start of input.
known_information: Notepad, WhatsApp, and Slack are reported affected.
Teams and VS Code were not affected for the original reporter.
The behavior depends on timing and accent position.
inferences: Application text-input timing may be involved, but this is unproven.
issue_context.analysis: A current minimal reproduction is required before grouping the native-app and browser-app variants.
initial_investigation: Reviewed the current public issue body, labels, assignees, and up to the latest 20 public comments returned by GitHub.
Kept the existing dashboard read-only; no dashboard files were modified or published.

information_gaps.information: Whether the deletion persists on current stable.
information_gaps.why_needed: The existing reports predate multiple Quick Accent releases.
information_gaps.how_to_collect: Retest in Notepad and one affected browser-based app.

information_gaps.information: A precise timing sequence and recording.
information_gaps.why_needed: The issue is intermittent and may contain two variants.
information_gaps.how_to_collect: Record the activation, selection, and key-release sequence.

actions.label: Request current Quick Accent deletion repro
actions.note: Draft candidate only; no comment or other write was made to microsoft/PowerToys.

comment.body:
The thread identifies deletion in Notepad and some browser-based apps, but the reports predate current Quick Accent releases. Could you retest on current stable and provide:
1. Whether it still occurs in Notepad and one affected browser-based app, including the activation key and whether the accent starts an empty field.
2. A short recording showing the activation, selection, and key-release timing so the native-app and browser-app variants can be compared.
